_meta: R4 FLAGSHIP CANDIDATE (NOT FROZEN): the tendon-driven finger -- ADR-0124's atom of the hand. THREE printed phalanges on pin joints, ONE tendon channel routed through all three, a horn spool on a single MG996R, elastic return. Servo BOUGHT/registry-mapped (horn BC 14.0 PHYSICALLY VERIFIED 2026-07-22). Gate: the tendon-routability audit (channel continuity, min bend radius >= 3 mm for 0.5 mm Spectra braid, total path length) -- deterministic from the STEP. PHYSICAL EXIT (founder-committed): the printed finger curls under one servo pull; fingertip force measured by fish scale, reported vs stall math as INFO never PASS. Teacher roster authors (cloud-first law); local inherits via the repair flywheel.

label: tendon_finger
prompt: A tendon-driven robot finger: three printed phalanges connected by pin joints, curled by ONE tendon (0.5 mm braided line) running through a continuous channel along the palm side of all three phalanges, pulled by a spool on an MG996R servo horn; an elastic band along the back side returns the finger straight. The servo is a bought part -- model only the printed parts around its cited interfaces.

servos.pose_note: Lying flat behind the finger base: shaft axis +Y, shaft exit plane at y=-30, shaft axis at z=+15 -- the spool winds the tendon roughly in line with the base phalanx channel entry.

plan.assembly_note: mount_base bolts the servo flange and carries the base pivot; proximal, middle, and tip phalanges chain on d3.2 pin bores (idler-bushing class); the tendon channel (d1.2) runs palm-side through all three with >=3 mm bend radius at each joint crossing; tendon_spool screws onto the servo horn (center d8.1, 4x d2.2 on BC 14.0) and anchors the tendon at a d20 winding drum; an elastic groove runs dorsal-side.

parts.name: mount_base
parts.prompt: The finger's base mount as ONE solid in the shared origin frame: a plate carrying the servo tab pattern (4x d4.5 on the cited 49.5 x 10.0 rectangle) for the drive servo lying at y=-30, an upright knuckle clevis at the origin with a d3.2 pin bore at z=+15 (axis +X), and a tendon guide hole d1.2 leading from the spool side through to the palm-side channel line. Walls >= 3.0 mm.

ports.name: servo_mount
ports.note: the tab-pattern face for the drive servo flange

ports.name: knuckle_pin
ports.note: the d3.2 clevis pin bore at the origin, axis +X

parts.name: proximal_phalanx
parts.prompt: The proximal phalanx as ONE solid: a rounded-box link 32 mm long, 14 mm wide, 12 mm tall, with a d3.2 pin bore at each end (axes +X, 26 mm apart), a palm-side tendon channel d1.2 running its full length with flared ends (>= 3 mm bend radius), and a dorsal elastic groove 3 x 1.5 mm. Walls >= 2.5 mm around the channel.

ports.name: base_pin
ports.note: proximal pin bore, mates the mount clevis

ports.name: mid_pin
ports.note: distal pin bore, mates the middle phalanx

parts.name: middle_phalanx
parts.prompt: The middle phalanx as ONE solid: same construction as the proximal but 26 mm long with pin bores 20 mm apart, palm-side d1.2 through-channel with flared ends, dorsal elastic groove. Walls >= 2.5 mm.

parts.name: tip_phalanx
parts.prompt: The fingertip as ONE solid: a rounded tapering tip 22 mm long with one d3.2 pin bore at its base, the tendon channel d1.2 ending at an internal anchor pocket 4 x 3 x 3 mm (the tendon knot seats here), a dorsal elastic anchor slot, and a flat 8 x 6 mm pad at the tip face for the pull-test scale hook. Walls >= 2.5 mm.

parts.name: tendon_spool
parts.prompt: The tendon spool as ONE solid: a winding drum d20 x 8 mm with a 1.5 mm deep helical groove, on a horn hub base -- center bore d8.1 and four horn screw holes d2.2 on the cited 14.0 mm bolt circle -- plus a d1.2 tendon anchor hole through the drum wall. Walls >= 2.0 mm.
